allocation: allocate_ready_o advertises a pre-cycle oldest prefix without retirement credit bypass. allocate_i is the final shared reservation mask, limited to 00/01/11. Slot identities pack generation[7:0] above index[4:0]. Lane zero occupies low packed bits. The caller terminates bundles at a CFI and enforces decode serialization barriers. The allocation PC is retained independently of completion so head_pc_o remains available for whole-window replay even if the head is unfinished.
identity: Each slot allows 256 allocations before reuse stalls. Flush, trap and selective recovery preserve generation counters and exhausted flags. identity_drain_o requests a producer drain when any slot exhausts its space. drained_i is legal only with an empty ROB, no allocation or response offers, and an external guarantee that ALL holders of previous identities, including canceled responses and resolution queues, have discarded them. It rearms generation counters; it does not reset architectural order. Reset requires the same global producer reset. No finite counter alone is claimed to reject arbitrarily old traffic across a drain/reset.
completion: complete_ready_o validates identity, unfinished state and the winning recovery cut independently of complete_take_i. The caller presents complete_offer_i and stable event/id/solo payload until final arbitration; a duplicate offered identity reserves lane zero. complete_take_i must be a subset of offered ready lanes, shared atomically with any required PRF write and wakeup. complete_accept_o acknowledges that final mask. Resultless instructions use this same ROB handshake without any PRF write. Late solo classification is sticky. There is no same-cycle completion-to-retirement bypass.
resolution: resolve_ready_o validates a live unresolved CFI identity. resolve_take_i is the globally accepted recovery-arbiter permission, shared with checkpoint resolution; resolve_accept_o is its acknowledgement. Correct resolution allows concurrent traffic. Misprediction retains the CFI and older entries, discards the younger suffix by circular distance from the head, suppresses rename/retirement, and permits only surviving completions. Link completion and resolution are separately remembered; both are necessary to retire a nonfaulting CFI.
retirement: retire_valid_o exposes completed resolved nonfaulting oldest entries, packed 00/01/11. Either solo entry limits the prefix so every solo operation retires alone. retire_take_i is the final event-sink and architectural-side-effect acceptance prefix and must be shared with committed rename, PRF ownership and any other commit consumers. ROB completion does not itself grant an external memory request. Head identity is exposed for a future head-operation controller. Outputs contain the stored event, replacing valid/order/retired; all other bits are preserved. Payload bits on invalid outputs are unspecified. Order counts accepted normal and trapped boundaries and survives internal flushes.
trap: A completed fault at the head is exposed separately even if it is a CFI with no normal resolution. trap_take_i accepts exactly one retired=0 boundary and flushes the uncommitted window. trap_accept_o must be shared atomically with the future CSR/trap transition, event sink and committed-state recovery. No destination commits. Stored trap payload is supplied by the producer; head-time CSR effects and the final trap target still require the future event/commit controller. A trap in slot one waits until it becomes the head; its older normal instruction can retire alone.
priority: Reset, external full-window flush, accepted head trap, accepted branch recovery, then ordinary traffic. Full flush suppresses all acknowledgements and preserves event order. An accepted trap defeats simultaneous branch resolution. Branch recovery suppresses allocation and retirement even if their inputs are asserted. A correct resolution does not release an unfinished link. Full-window replay uses the pre-cycle head before flushing.
scope: Standalone full-size ROB control, rename metadata and event storage. Not integrated with rename_recovery, PRF, IQ, execution producers, CSR/MMIO head controller, predictor or processor. Does not establish OOO differential correctness, liveness, formal proof or physical timing. Storing full event records is a bring-up implementation with generic synthesis evidence only. The future commit-only controller needs an atomic head-result/retirement path for CSR operations; the current registered completion path and solo flag do not implement CSR atomicity.
